Name: Grey-1220
bio:
[[Category: Howick, Northumberland, Gray Name Study]]
==Biography==
'''John Grey''' (living 1640; d. bef 1657), was a son of [[Grey-1113|Edward Grey]] of Howick, Northumberland and [[Le Strange-104|Catherine Le Strange]]
===Marriage===
His wife was '''Mary Hume'''. They are the parents of:
* Ralph
* Thomas
* Margaret
